investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Unschedulable: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Across All 3 Remote-Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent eval checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment with an identical Kubernetes scheduling error: the cluster's 6 nodes have zero remaining kata.peerpods.io/vm capacity (only 2 nodes carry this resource and both are exhausted), and the remaining 4 nodes do not match the pod's node affinity/selector. Because the agent pod could never be scheduled, the runner never received a VM ID or a ready state, so all four required evidence fields (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) are absent from the eval result.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the production-api remote-agent swarm has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm extended resource on the only two eligible nodes. No preemption victims exist, so incoming remote-agent pods are permanently Unschedulable until capacity is freed or additional kata-peerpods-capable nodes are added. This is an infrastructure capacity failure localized to the remote-agent VM scheduling layer; it is an eval-detected signal, and no user-traffic or incident evidence is present in the packet to confirm a broader production outage.

investigation.title: Remote Agent Pod Scheduling Failure: Exhausted kata.peerpods.io/vm Capacity Blocks All Remote Agent Checks
investigation.summary: All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed in the production-api environment because the Kubernetes scheduler could not place the required kata peer-pod VM: only 2 nodes carry the kata.peerpods.io/vm resource and both are fully exhausted, while the remaining 4 nodes do not satisfy the pod's node affinity/selector. The eval runner in infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs calls createAgent with type "remote" (line 1905), which triggers pod scheduling; because the pod never became schedulable, the probe timed out without producing any evidence, causing the expected-output contract for orgId, agentId, readyState, and state to be entirely unmet.
investigation.rootCause: The Kubernetes cluster backing the production-api remote-agent feature has exhausted its kata.peerpods.io/vm resource on the 2 eligible nodes. When the eval runner attempts to create a remote agent pod (infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs line 1905: createAgent with type "remote"), the scheduler reports "0/6 nodes are available: 2 Insufficient kata.peerpods.io/vm, 4 node(s) didn't match Pod's node affinity/selector" and preemption is not possible. The pod remains Unschedulable for the full probe window (~146s), the agent is never created, and no evidence (orgId, agentId, readyState, state) is written. This is an eval failure reflecting a real infrastructure capacity constraint in the production Kubernetes cluster; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence to confirm a broader user-facing outage.
